definitions.explanation: A system of interconnected communication lines and facilities for transmitting information. Covers telephone networks, internet infrastructure, broadcast networks, and other communication systems.

examples.japanese: {通信網|つうしんもう}が{整備|せいび}された。
{災害|さいがい}で{通信網|つうしんもう}が{寸断|すんだん}された。
examples.english: The communication network was disrupted by the disaster.

examples.japanese: {高速|こうそく}{通信網|つうしんもう}の{普及|ふきゅう}により、{地方|ちほう}でもリモートワークが{可能|かのう}になった。
examples.english: The spread of high-speed communication networks has made remote work possible even in rural areas.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {通信|つうしん} (communication) + {網|もう} (network, net). Used in news, business, and technical contexts. The {網|もう} suffix appears in many network-related compounds such as {交通網|こうつうもう} (transportation network) and {電話網|でんわもう} (telephone network).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通信網|つうしんもう}を{整備|せいび}する (to develop a communication network)
- {通信網|つうしんもう}が{寸断|すんだん}される (network is disrupted)
- {高速|こうそく}{通信網|つうしんもう} (high-speed communication network)
- {全国|ぜんこく}{通信網|つうしんもう} (nationwide communication network)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {回線|かいせん}: line, circuit — a single communication line or channel
- ネットワーク: network — the loanword equivalent, used more casually
